label: Salt dissociation 5ns: guidance of first-half mean vs second-half mean of the history
series: K2 (what the guidance is, not where it is)

conditions_definition.base: K15 expanded conditions: train 58 proteins (orig 4 + 54 additions), test 30 proteins (orig 2 + 28 additions), frozen split from K15 split.json, origin frame 10 (1 ns), history frames 0-10 (100 ps spacing), HistGBM (120 iters, lr 0.075, 31 leaves, min_samples_leaf 15, L2 0.02, seed 42) refit per condition, distance = minimum over charged heavy-atom pairs, bound 4.0 A, candidates = pairs salt-bridged at the origin frame.
conditions_definition.base_hist_D6: static + 6 history statistics (first, mean, std, min, last-first, fraction <= bound) over frames 0-10

base_reproduction.reference: K53 saltbridge_dissociation_carrier results.json (5 ns: static 0.4641, full hist6 0.5780, gain +0.1139, mean_only 0.5794)

caution: Base gain is small (+0.1139) and the test set is small (360 candidates, 139 positives), so ratios against the full gain are noisy. Per-protein candidate counts average ~12, so per-protein AUPRCs are noisy; proteins with 0 positives have no defined AUPRC and their ratios are not recorded.
verdict: 続いている状態が効いている
